fields.label: State
fields.options:
Ticket
Intake
Lot
Position
Invoiced
Settled
fields.description: Advanced only via the Advance State button - not directly editable.

fields.label: Parent Lot
fields.description: Set only when this Lot is the result of a split, merge, or re-bag. Null = original lot.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Set at Invoiced state.

fields.label: County
fields.description: Supplier-level attribute, not entered per Lot.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Supplier-level attribute, not entered per Lot.

fields.label: Aggregator
fields.description: Optional - set when purchased via an aggregator rather than direct from farmer.

fields.label: Transhipped
fields.description: Tick if load changed vehicle in transit. Widens the loss-tolerance check.

fields.label: Weighbridge Ticket Photo
fields.description: Uploading auto-fills gross weight, tare weight, vehicle registration, and ticket number below via OCR - all remain editable.

fields.label: Net Weight (kg)
fields.description: Gross minus tare, calculated.

fields.label: Bag Count
fields.description: Defaults to FLOOR(net weight / 90kg) - editable; a variance of more than 1 bag from that estimate is flagged, not blocked.

fields.label: Payable Weight (kg)
fields.description: Calculated: gross weight minus moisture divisor and foreign matter deduction.

fields.label: Storage Stack
fields.description: Set when Lot enters Position state and is held rather than sold direct.

fields.label: Commingled
fields.description: Auto-set if this stack already holds a Lot of different origin/grade.

fields.label: Moisture Band
fields.options:
Under 14 - Straight In
14 to 20 - Drying, Price Negotiated
Over 20 - Requires Approval

fields.label: Result Available Now
fields.description: Untick if sent to an external lab - intake will stay open until the result is entered.

fields.label: Aflatoxin (ppb)
fields.description: Limit is 10 ppb.

fields.label: Aflatoxin Tested
fields.description: Kept for the Cost Ledger test-fee calc; set automatically once a result is entered.

fields.label: Aflatoxin Result
fields.description: Set automatically from the ppb reading against the 10 ppb limit.

fields.label: Awaiting Lab Result
fields.description: Set automatically when Result Available Now is unticked. The Lot stays at Ticket state until this is completed.

fields.label: Override Reason
fields.description: Required to proceed when moisture exceeds 20% or aflatoxin fails the limit.

fields.label: Reason Code
fields.options:
Visual Condition
Origin Risk
New Supplier
Customer Requirement
fields.description: Required whenever a judgement field (foreign matter, sampling decision) is entered.

fields.label: Landed Cost / kg
fields.description: Sum of all Cost Ledger Entries for this lot / payable_weight_kg.
